skill.summary: Automate Brevo (Sendinblue) tasks via Rube MCP (Composio): manage email campaigns, create/edit templates, track senders, and monitor campaign performance. Always search tools first for current schemas.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of brevo-automation skill for automating Brevo (Sendinblue) tasks via Rube MCP (Composio).
- Supports managing email campaigns, creating/editing templates, listing verified senders, and configuring A/B testing.
- Requires Rube MCP connection and verified Brevo account setup.
- Provides comprehensive parameter and workflow guidance for all supported operations.
- Includes best practices, pitfalls, and response parsing tips for smooth automation.
